about: Caerdun's Sea Gate module library, generated by tools/assets/build_caerdun_modules.py -- do not edit by hand. The triangle ceilings live in client/test/caerdun_modules.test.mjs, never here.

curtain.colliders: body y -inf..11.4 over the section; parapet box to 13.2; parados box to 12.4 (none on a stair-landing bay)

shellDatums.flightsRule: every flight: a ramp on the nosing line with a 0.05 m end pad + a stair body (solid to the ground unless thickness given); decks that only touch overlap 0.25 m

gorgeLevel.doors: gorge face z 0 at x = +-8.0, 1.6 wide, 2.6 high (onto the plateau)

lighthouseRoom.door: the lighthouse door on its local -z face, centre (0, 3.9), 1.4 wide, OPEN: the stair comes up inside the tower and out of its door

platform.shape: half disc r 14.4 (local z >= 0) + the gorge strip x -16.5..16.5, z -1.5..0, minus the lighthouse (collider r 5.1)

sg_bastion.postern: strip level, facets 3 -> 7, clear 3.0 x 3.6; keeper door on facet 5 at local (0, 0, 16); both reach B1 foot

sg_chain_tower.door: local -z face (toward the mole root), 1.3 wide, y 1.6..4.0

sg_clock_tower.holes: floor k+1 over flight Kk: 2.5 x 5.6 along its wall

sg_crown_gate.note: local x -10.5 is the NORTH tower when placed at yaw pi/2 (world z = cz - lx)
sg_crown_gate.towerDoors: town face z -7.0 at x = +-10.5, 1.3 wide, y 0..2.6

sg_tower_corner.doors: centres (+-4.6, -4.6) on the back-diagonal faces, 1.3 wide, y 11.4..13.8

lodDistances.note: metres from the camera to the culling cell (contract section 6)

SG_Beam.about: no sheet of its own: its UVs are on sg_glow's e_beam / e_lamp pictures (bind sg_glow_e.png as its colour for the falloff)

facade.about: Caerdun's Sea Gate facade sheet: stone, far, joinery and glass stacked into one -- written by tools/assets/paint_caerdun_textures.py (caerdun_atlas.FACADE); do not edit by hand.
facade.name: SG_Facade
facade.uvOrder: [su, ou, sv, ov]: u' = u su + ou, v' = v sv + ov in glTF UVs (v down), as CL_FACADE

backFaceCulling: every material is single-sided (glTF doubleSided false): keep backFaceCulling on
vertexColor: baked ambient occlusion x per-surface tint in COLOR_0; set useVertexColors, hasVertexAlpha = false
uv: glTF convention (origin top-left): load every sheet with invertY = false

departures.sg_clock_tower.why: the contract's K0-K4 ran round the four walls and overlapped at every corner (K1's first steps 0.2-0.9 m over K0's last): they alternate between the +x and -x walls instead, half, run, rise, x and floors kept

sg_crown_gate.stairwells.why: the walk gallery crosses over F2 (F2 keeps 2.2 m); F4 opens under the caphouse only where it needs its headroom

sg_crown_gate.caphouseDoor.why: F4 arrives facing the back wall; the standard 1.3 m (1.0 m was too tight for the body)

towerDoors.why: CF-7: the walk meets a bent tower's flank 5 tan(bend/2) m inboard of the door's centre (0.98 m at n5): the doors open where the plan's colliders do (layout walls.doors)

sg_seagate.doors.why: fix round 1: the walk's width less a hand's breadth; at 1.3 m the curtains, meeting the flanks at a bend, left the body 0.24 m

departures.towerRooms: the walk rooms of sg_tower, sg_tower_tall and the Crown Gate towers have their front corners chamfered 1 m inside the outer diagonals; the contract rectangles poke 0.17-0.37 m out through the wall there
departures.lod2Cards: SG_Far only, cut to the silhouette: curtains and houses a front and a back face, towers, gates, halls and round towers a cross of four faces through the middle
departures.sg_roof_hip: END frame (origin on the ridge line in the end plane, +z outward): roofs the end bay (z -4..0.45); its slopes 2 cm over the ridge planes
departures.sg_stair_turret: flat crenellated cap (CF-3): 14.9 m to its merlon tops, where an sg_cone sits (the contract size 19.85 was the cone mock-up)
departures.sg_sign: the board hangs across the facade on its arm (+z): 0.06 x 1.13 x 1.51 m
departures.sg_lighthouse.core: the SG_Beam lamp is a band on the lantern glass at 32.6-33.8 (the glass is opaque: a core inside would never be seen)
departures.sg_crown_gate.flightsWhy: F3 (walk -> 17.75) and F4 (17.75 -> crown) rose 6.35 m: 31 risers of 0.205 against the 30 a flight may have. Each is split by a 1.0 m half-landing in its own lane (16 + 15 risers of 0.2048 on 0.30 treads); the 17.75 landing is taken back to z 4.7, and F4b still tops out under the caphouse
